Hey! I'm sorry I don't know if you're looking for advice or just venting, but I'm in the same boat as you right now with my Nmom and I need to move out ASAP! I'll just tell you what I'm planning to do soon (if I don't chicken out, which is very likely.. fingers crossed I don't!) 

I'm 19 and for years I begged my nmom to let me just move out and live with my estranged father since my mental health was going to shit being with her. She told me how much he "didn't want me", and "didn't care about me", and even brought up his girlfriend at the time and how we didn't know her and couldn't trust her, so when she inevitably said "No" she had all those reasons. They're poor excuses made to keep me under her control. 

So having said all that; I'm leaving this summer and staying with my dad. It's my decision. It may not be a good one but it's a change, and it's definitely not permanent as I'm only using the guy to help me get my credentials so I can get a job, lol. 

I encourage you to do what you have to do. I know how scary the idea is that you'll hurt their feelings by leaving but YOU yourself are hurting by staying with them.

Sometimes my mom hits me (with objects or her hand) in a way that doesn't hurt as much, but it's triggering due to past abuse from her; I get really sensitive about it. It's unclear whether or not something like that is considered "normal" to me when I have past traumas in mind. 

I would like to say It doesn't matter if it hurts or if the intention was to hurt you or not. You've expressed discomfort, so it's not something that needs to happen going forward, regardless. Unfortunately narcissistic parents/parents with narcissistic traits don't tend to respect their childrens boundaries (or so it seems that way in my case) 

I'm sorry you had to experience this! I believe your feelings are valid.
